scope: B02 record declarations and DetectorBase, lines 1–234 only
provenance: Separate same-assistant source-first pass. Group contracts derived directly from pinned source; category rows link coordinate and operation. Historical W1 interpretations retained separately. No embedded production implementation or runtime trace.

groups.interpretation: Module ownership declaration excludes downstream visibility/lifecycle decisions. Future annotations defer annotation evaluation under native language semantics; not trading decisions.
Import standard helpers before internal imports; resolution failure propagates during module load, no execution equivalence asserted.
Import core containment class, alias as_decimal to _decimal_value, then policy_for; module resolution is environment-dependent, native pinned definitions are authority.
Assign engine and implementation version and modified-time strings; metadata, not event chronology.
Declare gate cache cap 32768 and crossing cap 16384; no cache allocated by these constants.
Initialize new global dictionary keyed by sequence id, retaining sequence and time-list references. Annotation is declaration, not checked type.
Candle dataclass frozen/slotted; generated constructor stores supplied values without price normalization, chronology or tag validation.
Required Candle index, timestamp, display string, tag; distinct coordinates, no enforced equivalence or recomputation.
Required open/high/low/close references; Decimal annotations do not convert inputs or validate OHLC.
Candidate slotted mutable dataclass; assignments permitted, no automatic event selection.
Required First index/time, top and bottom source indexes/times/prices; independent provenance fields, no automatic synchronization.
Required mode string, no enforcement of A/B values here.
Optional anchor index/value, leg boundary, Break index/time, intrabar start all default None; absence distinct from numeric zero.
Cross-direction origin and chain-owner flags default False; order gate decision defaults None.
Public numbering, top/bottom and exact confirmation/First times default None; behavior_internal False. Not ownership proof or public projection by declaration.
ResetEvent frozen/slotted with all five fields required (second_time nullable but no default); no native timestamp field declared. broken_level not normalized here.
IntrabarAnalysis frozen/slotted, stores event-second Candle, extreme and separate owning main Candle; no guarantee they refer to same timestamp.
DetectionResult frozen/slotted shallow container of direction, mutable reaction/reset lists, start/end; frozen attributes do not freeze list or Candidate objects.
Normal cursor mutable/slotted; required next index, previous Candidate, nullable candidate, running price/source and nullable pending reset index. No automatic deep copies.
Checkpoint mutable/slotted with cursor reference and two counts; does not itself snapshot or roll back lists.
Initial leg cursor mutable/slotted; next index, state, nullable leg floor, started flag, anchor/origin/candidate required fields even when nullable.
Trend cursor mutable/slotted; next index, fixed source and nullable candidate required; lifecycle supplied by callers.
LiveReactionUnavailable derives RuntimeError; declaration only, not a local raise or runtime gate.
Native inclusive open<=close selects GREEN (finite equal Doji), else RED. No conversion/rounding; invalid comparison propagates.
Call shared policy_for with supplied direction; then read opposite property. Unsupported direction raises via native selector, no fallback.
DetectorBase signature retains supplied bounds and sequences without annotation enforcement.
Assign main/lower source references then selected start/end in order, not copies or validation.
Get main times first, lower times second, then shared lower range index; global cache writes can precede later failure.
Fresh instance reaction-break cache; not global registry, no invalidation here.
If len(main)>1 subtract timestamp[0] from timestamp[1] (read index 1 first), else one-second timedelta even empty input. No all-grid validation.
Call total_seconds, reject <=0 after cache preparation; native construction/subtraction errors propagate, no local rollback.
Static time-index helper; compute id(source) without sequence copy.
Lookup id, non-None test before exact stored-source identity; hit returns same time-list reference, no freshness check.
On miss extract timestamp attributes in source iteration order, assign pair(source,times) before return; no sort or validation.
Compute left and right bisect_left eagerly from cached lower times, half-open endpoints, no local normalization.
Return generator; range constructed at creation, element accesses lazy on iteration against self.seconds, positions increase; no synthetic gaps.
Right bisect on main times minus one; last equal open position, no independent timestamp normalization.
First compare position<start then if false position>end; outside selected inclusive bounds returns None before indexing.
Use next actual full-sequence timestamp if position+1<len, even beyond selected end; otherwise current timestamp+inferred timeframe. No explicit position>=0 guard apart from selected bounds.
Only timestamp<chosen end returns main row; equality/after returns None. No extra lower-bound comparison beyond bisect assumption.
Minimum query selects indexed path when end-start>=16 (17 inclusive rows), not >=16 rows.
Native reflected type check; index original sequence, range_maximum over [start,end+1), copy_negate returned price; position unchanged.
Other main sequence uses range_minimum on [start,end+1); return indexed price and corresponding current main (possibly reflected) row. Index normalizes leaves; caller must ensure alignment.
Linear route initializes at start unconditionally, then aliases main sequence; no empty/reversed or range check.
Visit start+1 through end inclusive; replace source only on strict lower Low, equality retains first; use native stored values without _decimal_value.
Return source.low and same row; reversed interval can return start row if valid, unlike rejecting invalid indexed queries.
Maximum uses same end-start>=16 threshold.
Reflected path queries original minimum then copy_negate, position unchanged.
Normal path uses range_maximum [start,end+1); return price and selected current row.
Linear route initializes source from start without validation; alias sequence.
Increasing inclusive scan, strict higher High only; earliest equal source remains. No normalization on linear path.
Return stored source.high and original/adapter row; failure and noncanonical input behavior differ from indexed route.

supplemental.historical: Postponed annotations; engine/version metadata, cache capacity constants 32768 and 16384; time index initialized empty. No calculation by declarations.

Record ownership: frozen slotted Candle, ResetEvent, IntrabarAnalysis, DetectionResult; mutable slotted candidate and cursors. Frozen container does not deep-freeze referenced lists. Candidate defaults preserve null versus false; actual cursor mutation reviewed at consumers.
Retain source object references and selected bounds, obtain main then lower time arrays then lower index, initialize empty per-detector reaction-break cache before timeframe validation.
Cache miss builds timestamps without reordering, stores original sequence and list; no mutation freshness test. Identity is necessary, not proof against external mutation.
Bounds computed eagerly; generator's range constructed at creation and element lookup lazy. No synthetic records or gap fill.

Last equal main open selected by upper bound. Actual next full-sequence timestamp may be outside selected end; used as bound, not nominal next time. No local clamping; invalid selected ranges not normalized.
Indexed path assumes valid index service; linear initializes source at start even if end before start, no explicit interval validation here. Indexed failure/tie semantics require later RE39 review.

limitations: Category overlap is not unique rule count. Group semantic contracts govern row roles; no empirical execution or consumer closure.
Native typing, data alignment and immutable-source assumptions are conditional.

findings.meaning: RE07/08 must distinguish native stored-price linear route from normalized indexed leaves, 17-row threshold, and reversed-range behavior; no universal equivalence for malformed inputs.
RE03/04 must explicitly state global cache publication precedes positive timeframe validation, identity is not freshness, no local rollback. RE05 generator bounds eager and row lookup lazy.
Shallow frozen result and mutable Candidate/cursor objects require direct copy, append, preview and rollback review; constructor annotations are not validators.

remaining: B02 ranges 235–885 and 1370–2908, full cross-owner review.
